text: Telephone Service Provider, Unified Access Service Provider, Universal Access Service Provider and Virtual Network Operator (VNO) as defined in the respective licenses issued by Department of Telecommunications (DoT); (c) “Act” means the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 (24 of 1997) (d) “Authority” means the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India established under sub-section (1) of section 3 of the Act; (e) “Auto Dialer Call” meansa call which is initiated automatically by an equipment, in accordance toa stored and/ or programmable instruction(s),to a telephone number(s),already stored or a list auto generated by the software,and once the call has been answered, equipment (iii) either plays a recorded message; or (iv) connects the call to a live person; (f) “Bulk” means number of messages or voice calls on the same or similar subject- matter sent, caused to be sent or authorized to be sent in excess of the following limits, which the Authority may, by direction or order specify from time to time: (i) more than 20 during a 24-hour period; or (ii) more than 100 during a seven days period; or (iii) more than 500 during a 30-day period; (g) “Business Day” means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday or National holiday; (h) “Calling Name or Number (CNAM)” means name or number which will be presented by the terminating access provider (TAP) to the recipient of a commercial communication and may be the header assigned to the sender or a name or number assigned by the access provider in lieu
